subject: Late payment surge — prioritisation request & CEO touchpoint
content:
Message 1/4
From: Karen Li <karen.li@orthogon.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Jun 2029 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Overdue invoices and request to avoid service interruption

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well. Our treasury group flagged a cluster of overdue invoices across three entities that are scheduled for escalation this month. We want to avoid any service interruptions — can you confirm receipt and advise the fastest path to get a short-term payment plan in place?

Outstanding items:
- Invoice 7789 (USD 92,400) — due 2029-05-15 — attached stub
- Invoice 7821 (USD 18,000) — due 2029-05-28
- Invoice 7902 (EUR 12,600) — due 2029-05-30 — VAT question (EU entity)

We can wire the USD invoices quickly if Redwood signs the standard payment plan and confirms VAT allocation for the EU invoice. Please advise next steps and contact for an expedited approval (we have a treasury cutoff on June 10).

Thanks,
Karen Li
Head of Treasury — Orthogon Inc.
Attachments: orthogon_invoice_7789.pdf (invoice stub)

---

Message 2/4
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@orthogon.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Jun 2029 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Overdue invoices and request to avoid service interruption

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear summary and the invoice stub. I’ve looped in Kimberly (Credit & Collections lead) to help operationalise a short payment plan and to confirm VAT handling for the EU invoice.

Quick answers:
- We can accept a staged payment plan that clears the USD invoices by June 14 if Orthogon can initiate the first wire by June 7.
- For the EUR invoice we need the VAT registration evidence for the EU entity (we’ve attached our payment_plan_template.xlsx for your treasury to complete).
- To avoid automatic dunning escalation, I’ll request an immediate stop-gap hold while we confirm the plan, but I need internal approval to suspend automated reminders past June 6.

Next steps I’m asking Kimberly to run:
1) Confirm whether to apply a one-week suspension on system dunning for DEAL-2187.
2) If suspended, put the account on a high-priority queue for manual collector outreach and confirm the invoice reallocation path for VAT.
3) Prepare one-page approval note for a potential CEO touchpoint if we hit roadblocks with the treasury cutoff.

Karen — can you complete the attached payment_plan_template.xlsx and return by EOD Tuesday (June 4)? That will keep us on schedule.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0126
Attachments: payment_plan_template.xlsx

---

Message 3/4 (internal)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2029 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Overdue invoices and request to avoid service interruption — prioritisation ask

Team — FWD from the customer. Important timing: Orthogon has a treasury cutoff on June 10 and wants the USD wires cleared by June 14. They’ve completed the invoice stub but not the VAT evidence yet.

Recommended operational approach:
- Put DEAL-2187 into Priority-1 queue (manual collector cadence: daily until first payment clears).
- Suspend automated dunning for 7 days (June 6–13) to allow manual outreach to complete — need sign-off from Jonas for the suspension and a one-off SLA exception.
- Assign Tessa to coordinate with Product/Legal on the EU VAT allocation question (likely requires entity mapping and tax proof).

Why I’m asking for an SLA exception / CEO read-in: if treasury misses the June 10 cutoff, they could escalate to procurement and ask for a credit hold across all Redwood services. A short CEO touchpoint will help unblock priority routing on their side and reduce the chance of cascading vendor holds.

Attachments referenced: orthogon_invoice_7789.pdf, payment_plan_template.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Head — Credit & Collections
Redwood Inference

Message 4/4
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karen Li <karen.li@orthogon.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Overdue invoices and request to avoid service interruption

Thanks for the context and the suggested approach. I’ve approved:
- One-week suspension of automated dunning (June 6–13) for DEAL-2187.
- Move Orthogon to Priority-1 manual collector queue immediately.
- Tessa: please start entity tax validation for the EUR invoice; escalate any ambiguity to Legal.

Operational plan and owners:
- Ava: confirm with Karen that the payment_plan_template.xlsx is received and that they’ll initiate the USD wire by June 7.
- Kimberly: lead the manual collector cadence and update the collections tracker daily.
- Tessa: tax/VAT evidence collection and legal check (deliverable: tax allocation note by Jun 9).
- I will put this on my CEO briefing list if we don’t have a concrete first-payment confirmation by June 9.

Karen — appreciate the quick turnaround on the template. If you can get the first wire queued by Friday (June 7), we’ll withhold service escalation and proceed with normal provisioning. If not, I’ll schedule the CEO touchpoint for June 11 morning to clear any procurement-level blocks.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
